powers.name: Drop in water

params.text: turns a pint of water fresh and drinkable

powers.text: It turns a pint of water fresh and drinkable. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: Turns up to a pint of liquid into fresh water.
text: Drop this tasteless, spongy, jelly-like bead into a liquid and it dissolves, turning as much as a pint of that liquid into cold, clean drinking water. Magical liquids and harmful substances such as poison are unaffected.
